summary: Retested after admin window.confirm/prompt -> in-app ConfirmAction dialog refactor. Updated admin-user-management and admin-remove-restore-listing browser checks for the new dialog pattern, added a new admin-swaps-transactions-review browser check, rewrote swap-confirmed-tracker to build its own fresh/idempotent paid-swap fixture (via a real signed Stripe webhook call instead of a hardcoded swap id), added 3 backend test files for the admin user/listing/swap API criteria, and re-ran every previously-passing browser check plus the full backend suite. Everything passes.
action_items: Discovered-and-fixed-in-place (not an app bug, a test-authoring pitfall): admin-user-management.mjs previously called page.request.post('/api/auth/login', ...) for the throwaway test user while reusing the SAME browser context as the signed-in admin; since page.request shares the context's cookie jar, that login silently replaced the admin's session_token cookie, so later admin actions (make-admin/revoke-admin) sent requests under the wrong session and appeared to do nothing. Fixed by snapshotting and restoring the admin's session_token cookie around each such call. No application code was touched.

checks.criterion: Admin user management via in-app dialogs (suspend/unsuspend login gating, make/revoke admin, remove listings, delete requires typing DELETE, own row shows You, audit log)
checks.name: admin-user-management
checks.evidence: 12 screenshots incl. make-admin-dialog, user-made-admin, user-revoked-admin, remove-listings-dialog, listings-removed, delete-dialog-blocked (confirm disabled pre-DELETE), user-deleted, own-row-shows-you; re-ran twice for idempotency, both passed.

checks.criterion: Admin user management API (suspend/role/delete, role rejection for non-admin)
checks.name: test_tscheck_admin_user_management.py
checks.evidence: POST /admin/users/{id}/suspend -> 200, blocked login -> 403, unsuspend -> login 200; POST .../role admin/user toggles verified via GET /admin/users?q=; DELETE /admin/users/{id} -> 200, post-delete login -> 401; non-admin suspend attempt -> 403.

checks.criterion: Admin remove/restore listing with pre-filled reason dialog
checks.name: admin-remove-restore-listing
checks.evidence: 4 screenshots: remove-dialog-prefilled (reason input has default value), listing-removed (Restore button appears), listing-restored; GET /api/items/{id} confirmed 404 while removed and 200/available after restore.

checks.name: test_tscheck_admin_remove_restore_listing.py
checks.evidence: POST /admin/items/{id}/remove -> 200, GET /items/{id} -> 404; POST .../restore -> 200, GET /items/{id} -> 200 status=available; non-admin remove attempt -> 403.

checks.criterion: Admin swaps + transactions review (status filter pills, cancel-swap dialog, transactions refund column)
checks.name: admin-swaps-transactions-review
checks.evidence: 7 screenshots: swaps-filter-pending shows fixture row, swaps-filter-accepted excludes it, cancel-swap-dialog, swap-cancelled (visible under cancelled filter), transactions-tab + transactions-refund-column; GET /api/items/{offered_item_id} confirmed freed back to available after cancel. Re-ran twice, both passed.

checks.criterion: Admin swap cancel API frees reserved items
checks.name: test_tscheck_admin_swaps_cancel.py
checks.evidence: create+accept swap -> item status reserved; POST /admin/swaps/{id}/cancel -> 200; GET /items/{id} -> available; swap appears under /admin/swaps?status=cancelled; non-admin cancel -> 403.

checks.name: admin-login-and-access-control
checks.evidence: non-admin /admin -> admin-forbidden visible; admin login lands on /admin with admin-portal visible; avatar menu shows Admin portal link.

checks.criterion: Admin access control API (401 anonymous, 403 non-admin, 200 admin)
checks.name: test_tscheck_admin_access_control.py
checks.evidence: GET /admin/stats anonymous -> 401; with non-admin bearer -> 403; admin login -> role=admin, /admin/stats -> 200 with users/open_reports keys.

checks.criterion: Regression: swap row + postage tracker after refactor (fresh swap -> accept -> pay -> posted -> received -> rated)
checks.name: swap-confirmed-tracker
checks.evidence: Fixture creates swap via /api/swaps, accepts via Aoife token, pays via /api/payments/swap-fee + a genuinely HMAC-signed /api/stripe/webhook call (same trust boundary the real webhook checks), confirmed swap.status=accepted & fee_paid=true; UI then shows 4-step tracker, buy-label dialog, posts tracking, marks received, submits a 5-star rating -> 'You rated' pill. Ran 3 times total (first full run + 2 idempotent reuse reruns), all passed without touching seeded rows permanently (items reset to available afterward per seed_facts cleanup note).

checks.name: email-password-register-login
checks.evidence: Signup -> dashboard, wrong password -> toast, correct password -> signed in, duplicate email -> 409 toast. Also re-ran once through the public ingress URL https://swap-nest.preview.emergentagent.com with identical result.

checks.name: browse-list-propose-regression
checks.evidence: Browse fee badges visible; new listing created with photo upload; propose-swap dialog opens and offer reaches pending status.

checks.name: report-listing-and-admin-review
checks.evidence: Non-owner reports a fresh item; admin Reports tab shows it and resolves as item_removed; GET /api/items/{id} -> 404 afterward.

checks.name: propose-swap-flow
checks.evidence: Propose dialog shows swap-fee €7.00; offer lands in My offers as pending with a Cancel button.

checks.name: owner-accept-offer
checks.evidence: Owner (Aoife) accepts a fresh pending offer; status becomes awaiting fee, 'waiting for Test to pay' shown.

checks.name: proposer-pay-button
checks.evidence: Pay €7.00 button visible with countdown + Cancel; clicking redirects to checkout.stripe.com.

checks.name: facebook-login-disabled-ui, test-login-dashboard-greeting
checks.evidence: Both re-ran clean; facebook button disabled state and test-session dashboard greeting unchanged.

notes: Matrix had 5 listed criteria but 2 are compound (admin user management + admin listing/swap/tx review each cover multiple sub-flows); counted as 9 distinct checkable criteria across backend+browser lanes plus the 4 'previously passing' regression criteria (6 named browser checks) = 15 criteria, 23 artifacts total (9 new/updated this session: 3 backend test files + admin-user-management update + admin-remove-restore-listing update + new admin-swaps-transactions-review + rewritten swap-confirmed-tracker, plus 8 pre-existing regression checks re-verified).

One pre-existing cross-check fixture conflict found and resolved (not a bug): swap-confirmed-tracker's full payment completion permanently sets seed-camera/seed-test-lamp to 'swapped', which temporarily blocked propose-swap-flow/owner-accept-offer/proposer-pay-button (they reuse the same two seed items for pending/awaiting-payment fixtures). Per seed_facts guidance, reset those two items back to 'available' via direct DB update after the tracker run; all four checks then passed independently and swap-confirmed-tracker's own rerun logic (which looks up its fixture swap by id, not by item availability) was verified unaffected by the reset.
Cleared backend/login_attempts collection at start and end of the run to avoid 429 lockouts from the many admin logins across checks, per seed_facts.

Spec deviations respected: shipping labels remain DEMO, Facebook login stays disabled, simulated (webhook-signed) payments are refundable:false by design (covered by the pre-existing test_tscheck_refund_restriction.py, still passing).
